title: Apana Logistics IPO Details
intro:
Apana Logistics IPO is a fixed issue price of ₹34.14 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 56.90 lakh shares of ₹34.14 crore.

Apana Logistics IPO opens for subscription on Sep 7, 2026 and closes on Sep 9, 2026. The allotment for the Apana Logistics IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 10, 2026. Apana Logistics IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 15, 2026.

Apana Logistics IPO is set final issue price at ₹60 per share. The lot size for an application is 2,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,40,000 (4,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (6,000 shares), amounting to ₹3,60,000.

Corporate Makers Capital Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Apana Logistics IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 1992, Apana Logistics Ltd. is engaged in the business of providing comprehensive logistics support for the handling and transportation of containers.

The Company offers diversified services including Container Handling at Container Freight Stations (CFS), Inland Container Depots (ICD), and ports, road transportation, cargo handling at third-party warehouses, and the repair, operation, and maintenance of truck-trailers (TT).
The Company serves some of the top leading CFS/ICD/Port Operators in India and focuses on delivering cost and time-effective solutions to its customers.
As of August 31, 2025, the Company owned and maintained a fleet size of thirty-three (33) truck-trailers and five (5) reach stackers.

Apana Logistics caters to more than 10 customers, with strong and long-established relationships, including two of its top five customers who have been associated with the Company for over 10 years. As of August 31, 2025, the Company had 85 permanent employees.

faqs.question: How to apply in Apana Logistics IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Apana Logistics IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Apana Logistics IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Apana Logistics IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Apana Logistics IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Apana Logistics IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Apana Logistics IPO opens on Mon, Sep 7, 2026 and closes on Wed, Sep 9, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Apana Logistics IPO?
faqs.answer: Apana Logistics IPO lot size is 2000 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,40,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Apana Logistics IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Apana Logistics IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Apana Logistics IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Apana Logistics IPO will be done on Thursday, September 10, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Fri, Sep 11, 2026 . Check the Apana Logistics IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Apana Logistics IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Apana Logistics IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Tue, Sep 15, 2026 .
